7848: verus! {
7849: 
7850: tokenized_state_machine!{
7851:     #[cfg_attr(verus_keep_ghost, verifier::reject_recursive_types(T))]
7852:     RwLockSpec<T> {
7853:         fields {
7854:             #[sharding(constant)]
7855:             pub user_inv: ISet<T>,
7856: 
7857:             #[sharding(constant)]
7858:             pub rc_width: int,
7859: 
7860:             #[sharding(storage_option)]
7861:             pub storage: Option<T>,
7862: 
7863:             #[sharding(variable)]
7864:             pub exc_locked: bool,
7865: 
7866:             #[sharding(map)]
7867:             pub ref_counts: Map<int, int>,
7868: 
7869:             #[sharding(option)]
7870:             pub exc_pending: Option<int>,
7871: 
7872:             #[sharding(option)]
7873:             pub exc_guard: Option<()>,
7874: 
7875:             #[sharding(multiset)]
7876:             pub shared_pending: Multiset<int>,
7877: 
7878:             #[sharding(multiset)]
7879:             pub shared_guard: Multiset<(int, T)>,
7880:         }
7881: 
7882:         init!{
7883:             initialize(rc_width: int, init_t: T, user_inv: ISet<T>,) {
7884:                 require(0 < rc_width);
7885:                 require(user_inv.contains(init_t));
7886:                 init rc_width = rc_width;
7887:                 init user_inv = user_inv;
7888:                 init storage = Option::Some(init_t);
7889:                 init exc_locked = false;
7890:                 init ref_counts = Map::new(
7891:                     Set::range(0, rc_width),
7892:                     |i| 0,
7893:                 );
7894:                 init exc_pending = Option::None;
7895:                 init exc_guard = Option::None;
7896:                 init shared_pending = Multiset::empty();
7897:                 init shared_guard = Multiset::empty();
7898:             }
7899:         }
7900: 
7901:         transition!{
7902:             exc_start() {
7903:                 require(!pre.exc_locked);
7904:                 update exc_locked = true;
7905:                 add exc_pending += Some(0);
7906:             }
7907:         }
7908: 
7909:         transition!{
7910:             exc_check_count() {
7911:                 remove exc_pending -= Some(let r);
7912:                 have ref_counts >= [r => 0];
7913: 
7914:                 add exc_pending += Some(r + 1);
7915:             }
7916:         }
7917: 
7918:         transition!{
7919:             exc_finish() {
7920:                 remove exc_pending -= Some(pre.rc_width);
7921:                 add exc_guard += Some(());
7922: 
7923:                 birds_eye let x = pre.storage.unwrap();
7924: 
7925:                 withdraw storage -= Some(x);
7926:                 assert(pre.user_inv.contains(x));
7927:             }
7928:         }
7929: 
7930:         transition!{
7931:             exc_release(t: T) {
7932:                 require(pre.user_inv.contains(t));
7933:                 update exc_locked = false;
7934:                 remove exc_guard -= Some(());
7935:                 deposit storage += Some(t);
7936:             }
7937:         }
7938: 
7939:         transition!{
7940:             shared_start(r: int) {
7941:                 remove ref_counts -= [r => let rc];
7942:                 add ref_counts += [r => rc + 1];
7943:                 add shared_pending += {r};
7944:             }
7945:         }
7946: 
7947:         transition!{
7948:             shared_abandon(r: int) {
7949:                 remove ref_counts -= [r => let rc];
7950:                 require(rc > 0);
7951:                 add ref_counts += [r => rc - 1];
7952:                 remove shared_pending -= {r};
7953:             }
7954:         }
7955: 
7956:         transition!{
7957:             shared_finish(r: int) {
7958:                 require(!pre.exc_locked);
7959:                 remove shared_pending -= {r};
7960: 
7961:                 birds_eye let t = pre.storage.unwrap();
7962:                 add shared_guard += {(r, t)};
7963: 
7964:                 assert(pre.user_inv.contains(t));
7965:             }
7966:         }
7967: 
7968:         transition!{
7969:             shared_release(val: (int, T)) {
7970:                 remove shared_guard -= {val};
7971: 
7972:                 let r = val.0;
7973:                 remove ref_counts -= [r => let rc];
7974:                 add ref_counts += [r => rc - 1];
7975: 
7976:                 assert(rc > 0) by {
7977:                     assert(0 <= r < pre.rc_width);
7978:                     assert(pre.shared_guard.count(val) > 0);
7979:                     assert(Self::filter_r(pre.shared_guard, r).count(val) > 0);
7980:                     assert(Self::filter_r(pre.shared_guard, r).len() > 0);
7981:                     assert(pre.ref_counts.index(r) > 0);
7982:                 };
7983:             }
7984:         }
7985: 
7986:         property!{
7987:             do_guard(val: (int, T)) {
7988:                 have shared_guard >= {val};
7989:                 guard storage >= Some(val.1);
7990:             }
7991:         }
7992: 
7993:         property!{
7994:             rc_not_zero_guard(r: int) {
7995:                 have shared_pending >= {r};
7996:                 have ref_counts >= [r => let rc];
7997:                 assert(rc > 0);
7998:             }
7999:         }
8000: 
8001: 
8002: 
8003:         #[invariant]
8004:         pub fn sto_user_inv(&self) -> bool {
8005:             self.storage matches Some(storage) ==>
8006:                 self.user_inv.contains(storage)
8007:         }
8008: 
8009:         #[invariant]
8010:         pub fn ref_counts_domain(&self) -> bool {
8011:             &&& 0 < self.rc_width
8012:             &&& forall |i: int| 0 <= i < self.rc_width <==> self.ref_counts.dom().contains(i)
8013:         }
8014: 
8015:         #[invariant]
8016:         pub fn exc_inv(&self) -> bool {
8017:             &&& self.exc_locked <==> (self.exc_pending.is_some() || self.exc_guard.is_some())
8018:             &&& self.storage.is_some() <==> self.exc_guard.is_none()
8019:             &&& if let Option::Some(cur_r) = self.exc_pending {
8020:                 &&& 0 <= cur_r <= self.rc_width
8021:                 &&& self.exc_guard.is_none()
8022:                 &&& forall |x| self.shared_guard.count(x) > 0 ==> !(0 <= x.0 < cur_r)
8023:             } else {
8024:                 true
8025:             }
8026:         }
8027: 
8028:         #[invariant]
8029:         pub fn shared_pending_in_range(&self) -> bool {
8030:             forall |r| self.shared_pending.count(r) > 0 ==> (0 <= r < self.rc_width)
8031:         }
8032: 
8033:         #[invariant]
8034:         pub fn shared_guard_in_range(&self) -> bool {
8035:             forall |x| self.shared_guard.count(x) > 0 ==> (0 <= x.0 < self.rc_width)
8036:         }
8037: 
8038:         #[invariant]
8039:         pub fn shared_inv_agree(&self) -> bool {
8040:             forall |v| #[trigger] self.shared_guard.count(v) > 0 ==>
8041:                 self.storage === Option::Some(v.1)
8042:         }
8043: 
8044:         pub closed spec fn filter_r(shared_guard: Multiset<(int, T)>, r: int) -> Multiset<(int, T)> {
8045:             shared_guard.filter(|val: (int, T)| val.0 == r)
8046:         }
8047: 
8048:         #[invariant]
8049:         pub fn shared_counts_agree(&self) -> bool {
8050:             forall |r| 0 <= r < self.rc_width ==>
8051:                 #[trigger] self.ref_counts.index(r) ==
8052:                     self.shared_pending.count(r) as int +
8053:                         Self::filter_r(self.shared_guard, r).len() as int
8054:         }
8055: 
8056:         #[inductive(initialize)]
8057:         fn initialize_inductive(post: Self, rc_width: int, init_t: T,  user_inv: ISet<T>) {
8058:             assert forall |r| 0 <= r < post.rc_width implies
8059:                 #[trigger] post.ref_counts.index(r) ==
8060:                     post.shared_pending.count(r) as int +
8061:                         Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, r).len() as int
8062:             by {
8063:                 assert(post.ref_counts.index(r) == 0);
8064:                 assert(post.shared_pending.count(r) == 0);
8065:                 assert(Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, r) =~= Multiset::empty());
8066:                 assert(Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, r).len() == 0);
8067:             }
8068:             assert(post.shared_counts_agree());
8069:         }
8070: 
8071:         #[inductive(exc_start)]
8072:         fn exc_start_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
8073: 
8074:         }
8075: 
8076:         #[inductive(exc_check_count)]
8077:         fn exc_check_count_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
8078:             let prev_r = pre.exc_pending.unwrap();
8079:             assert forall |x| #[trigger] post.shared_guard.count(x) > 0
8080:                 && x.0 == prev_r implies false
8081:             by {
8082:                 assert(Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, prev_r).count(x) > 0);
8083:             }
8084:         }
8085: 
8086:         #[inductive(exc_finish)]
8087:         fn exc_finish_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self) {
8088:         }
8089: 
8090:         #[inductive(exc_release)]
8091:         fn exc_release_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, t: T) {
8092: 
8093:         }
8094: 
8095:         #[inductive(shared_start)]
8096:         fn shared_start_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, r: int) { }
8097: 
8098:         #[inductive(shared_abandon)]
8099:         fn shared_abandon_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, r: int) { }
8100: 
8101:         #[inductive(shared_finish)]
8102:         fn shared_finish_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, r: int) {
8103:             let t = pre.storage.unwrap();
8104: 
8105:             assert forall |r0| 0 <= r0 < post.rc_width implies
8106:                 #[trigger] post.ref_counts.index(r0) ==
8107:                     post.shared_pending.count(r0) as int +
8108:                         Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, r0).len() as int
8109:             by {
8110:                 if r == r0 {
8111:                     assert(pre.shared_pending =~= post.shared_pending.add(Multiset::singleton(r)));
8112:                     assert(Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, r) =~= Self::filter_r(pre.shared_guard, r).add(Multiset::singleton((r, t))));
8113:                     assert(post.ref_counts.index(r0) ==
8114:                         post.shared_pending.count(r0) as int +
8115:                             Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, r0).len() as int);
8116:                 } else {
8117:                     assert(Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, r0) =~= Self::filter_r(pre.shared_guard, r0));
8118:                     assert(post.ref_counts.index(r0) ==
8119:                         post.shared_pending.count(r0) as int +
8120:                             Self::filter_r(post.shared_guard, r0).len() as int);
8121:                 }
8122:             }
8123:         }
8124: 
8125:         #[inductive(shared_release)]
8126:         fn shared_release_inductive(pre: Self, post: Self, val: (int, T)) {

2779:                 flat_combiner@.instance_id() == self.flat_combiner_instance@.id(),

2783:                     #[trigger] flat_combiner@.value().get_Collecting_0()[i as int]).is_some(),

2797:                         &&& updates[i].key() == request_ids[i as int]

2801:                 rids_match(
2802:                     flat_combiner@.value().get_Collecting_0(),
2803:                     request_ids,
2804:                     0,
2805:                     flat_combiner@.value().get_Collecting_0().len(),
2806:                     0,
2807:                     request_ids.len(),

2816:                 returning num_ops;
2817:                 ghost g 
2818:             => {
2819:                 if num_ops == 1 {

2821: 
2822:                     rids_match_add_rid(flat_combiner.view().value().get_Collecting_0(), request_ids,

2830:                     g.batch_perms = None;

2836:                     update_req = None;
